a test-management CLI). Swap them for your chosen runner and TMS; the swap layer in
support/qa-automation/ and config/environments.ts is where the product-specific wiring lives.
Replace <RUNNER_TEST_CMD> etc. during `init`, or keep the reference runner to clone-and-run.
